name: Unnamed U.S. nuclear utility placement near-miss

attribution.legal_posture: Deep reporting is based on Nisos investigation and placement-firm disclosure; affected-utility confirmation is absent from the reviewed material.

caveats: Identify the utility only from a direct source; contextual clues alone are insufficient.
The source describes defensive context around ICS; live access, compromise, sabotage, and safety impact are outside the stated finding.
The nuclear-utility near miss describes the underlying Nisos cell; it contributes to that cell’s account.
This record holds aggregate or contextual material rather than a named worker or persona.

statements: Rubrik's July 8 companion to episode 2 reported that a placement firm disclosed a tracked worker had been placed at a U.S. nuclear utility.
Discord screenshots appeared to show an industrial-control-system panel, but follow-up established it was a training screen and not evidence of live operational-system access.
The worker had already been fired before Nisos notified the company. The utility, worker identity, role, duration and access scope were withheld.
